# Upload to URL

Upload files to public CDN URLs, retrieve or delete uploaded file metadata, and publish HTML pages.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/upload-to-url/.

## Actions

- **Delete File**: Permanently delete a previously uploaded file from storage and its public CDN location.
- **Get File Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve current metadata and the public CDN URL for a file previously uploaded by the connected account.
- **Get Supported Formats** (read-only): Return the file extensions Upload to URL accepts or blocks, current plan size limits, and advertised upload security checks.
- **Publish HTML**: Publish raw HTML at a public URL under a chosen page path.
- **Upload File**: Upload one file and return its public CDN URL, file ID, expiration, and remaining monthly credits.
